responsibility: Implements GCC’s emitter for BPF Type Format (BTF) debug data, using the shared CTF container as its input representation and serializing a .BTF section in assembler form. This file owns the CTF-to-BTF type-ID remapping and postprocessing needed to make BTF-valid type graphs, including elimination of unrepresentable or redundant CTF types, canonical handling of void, conversion of CTF function types into separate BTF FUNC_PROTO and FUNC records, construction of VAR and DATASEC records for variables and output sections, and final emission of the BTF header, type records, section-variable metadata, and string table.
